s1.syndrome_frame: A patient with a history of type 2 diabetes and hypertension presents with symptoms of fatigue, light-headedness, and dyspnea on exertion, and has abnormal heart rhythm and conduction
salient_findings: Abnormal heart rate of 47 beats per minute
Some P waves do not conduct to ventricles
key_facts: Patient is in their 70s
Patient has a medical history of type 2 diabetes
Patient has a medical history of hypertension
Patient presented with fatigue
Patient presented with light-headedness
Patient presented with dyspnea on exertion
Patient has a heart rate of 47 beats per minute
Patient has a blood pressure of 148/59 mm Hg
ECG findings show normal sinus rhythm at 72 beats per minute
ECG findings show prolonged PR interval
ECG findings show some P waves do not conduct to ventricles
ECG findings show right bundle-branch block
Echocardiogram shows normal biventricular function
Echocardiogram shows no significant valvular lesions
Electrophysiology Study shows prolonged His-ventricular interval
